def f(a, b):
    """Returns the length of the reduced fraction a/b written as signed numerator plus positive denominator; returns 0 when b is 0."""
    if b == 0:
        return 0
    x = a
    y = b
    while y:
        x, y = y, x % y
    g = x if x >= 0 else -x
    num = a // g
    den = b // g
    if den < 0:
        num = -num
        den = -den
    return len(str(num)) + len(str(den))
